purpose: Prospectively test PBE clean-Cu(111) numerical stability and the non-kinetic low-coverage adsorption-site ordering gate before any CO/Cu(111) diffusion barrier is calculated.

inherited_stage_a_settings.pseudopotential_bundle: unchanged exact Stage A PBE Cu/C/O bundle

forbidden_inputs: CO/Cu(111) hopping rate or diffusion coefficient

electrostatic_convention.reason: Use a slab-specific open-boundary electrostatic convention already executable in the pinned QE infrastructure, frozen before surface results and independent of kinetic information.

clean_surface.surface_cell: primitive Cu(111) 1x1 hexagonal cell derived from the frozen Stage A bulk lattice constant
clean_surface.candidate_matrix_rule: execute the complete Cartesian product of candidate layers, vacuum values and k meshes
clean_surface.surface_excess_definition: (E_slab_fixed_geometry_scf - N_Cu * E_bulk_selected_per_atom) / 2 for the symmetric 1x1 slab; units are eV per surface atom per face
clean_surface.reference_audit_rule: The 11-layer/24-A/k20 terminal reference must reproduce within 0.001 eV per surface atom of the independently executed 13-layer/28-A/k24 audit before any candidate can select.
clean_surface.candidate_pass_rule: A candidate must complete relaxation, satisfy the 0.02 eV/A movable-force gate, reproduce its relaxed total energy in an independent fixed-geometry SCF within 0.001 eV, and have surface excess within 0.001 eV per surface atom of the audited terminal reference.
clean_surface.selection_rule: Choose the passing candidate with minimum estimated cost layers*kmesh^2*cell_z; break ties by fewer layers, smaller vacuum, then smaller k mesh.

adsorption_site_ordering.slab_source: selected clean-surface geometry expanded 4x4 without changing its layer count, in-plane lattice constant or relaxed layer z coordinates; adsorption vacuum may only be increased to the separately frozen minimum below
adsorption_site_ordering.adsorbate_orientation: C-down CO normal to the surface

site_identity_constraints.C: x and y fixed at the named high-symmetry site; z movable
site_identity_constraints.O: x and y fixed collinear with C; z movable

adsorption_site_ordering.site_energy_definition: Compare fixed-geometry SCF total energies at equal composition; DeltaE_site = E_site - E_top, in eV per CO. Absolute adsorption energy is not used for PBE method selection.
adsorption_site_ordering.numerical_site_energy_sensitivity_defini: Maximum over bridge, fcc_hollow and hcp_hollow of |DeltaE_primary(site)-DeltaE_k6_audit(site)|.
adsorption_site_ordering.minimum_margin_rule: top must be lower than every competing site in the primary calculation by more than two times the measured numerical site-energy sensitivity; the k6 audit must also preserve top as the global minimum.
